description: Use when the user asks whether prices for an event are rising or falling, whether to buy now or wait for a price drop, or what an event has been doing lately. Returns the daily closing get-in price on the XP marketplace, one point per day, oldest first, with the fee-inclusive per-ticket price in dollars. This is the asking side over time -- what tickets actually sold for is `get_recent_sales`, and the two must not be conflated. An empty history is a real answer and a common one: XP records history only for events someone is tracking, so a quiet event has no line rather than a flat one.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market or search_events.
